pairs.subject: client-fetch-cache
pairs.evidence: src/components/modules/evaluator/CodebaseArcheologistView/index.tsx:29 CodebaseArcheologistView holds its expensive POST /api/codebase-archeologist result in component state and reruns it on every mount (line 59), so each tab return repaints cold and pays for a full analysis again. The GDD doc cache next to it has no lifetime, and its key leaves out the feature-matrix state the synthesis reads.

techniques.evidence: src/components/modules/evaluator/CodebaseArcheologistView/index.tsx:29 The analysis is view-scoped and has no module-level slot, so it dies on unmount and is recomputed cold on every mount.

src/hooks/useGameDesignDoc.ts:78 The key is project name, project id and checklist hash, but gdd-synthesizer.ts also reads feature_matrix and review_snapshots. A review that changes statuses leaves the key unchanged, so the old document is served.
src/hooks/useGameDesignDoc.ts:61 The single slot has no fetchedAt or TTL, so a key match is believed forever. The warm paint never revalidates unless the user presses refresh.
src/stores/gddComplianceStore.ts:225 A second ensureAudit during a flight is refused rather than joined. The result still reaches every caller because it lands in the shared store.
